# Purpose

This standalone workflow visualizes approximate migration paths using finalized
cleaned detections and actual release dates. It does not require output from
`bay_exit_analysis.Rmd`. Exit classification and reviewer sensitivity analyses
are maintained in that separate document.

Required input files are `det_clean_no_release_site_det.rds`,
`predation_events_clean.rds`, and `meta_clean.rds`, the same cleaned biological
inputs used for the habitat GAM and exit analysis. Detections must contain
`fish`, `dt`, `station`, `lon`, and `lat`; metadata require `fish`, `release_dt`;
finalized predation events require `fish`, `predation_dt`.

Coastline and Stewiacke River layers are drawn behind every movement panel.
By default, the layers use `rnaturalearthhires::countries10` and `lennox::stewi`,
as in the original mapping script. Install these packages before knitting, or
supply local spatial files in the settings below. Layers are cached as RDS
files in the output folder so subsequent renders can run without these two
source packages. No packages are installed during knitting. All receivers
remain eligible; map layers and display limits do not filter the analysis.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
required_packages <- c("dplyr", "tidyr", "readr", "lubridate", "ggplot2", "knitr", "sf")
missing_packages <- required_packages[!vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace,
                                             logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing_packages)) stop("Install required packages: ",
                                   paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
invisible(lapply(required_packages, library, character.only = TRUE))
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE,
                     fig.align = "center", dpi = 300)
```

```{r settings}
cohort_levels <- c("April", "December")
excluded_stations <- c("RELEASESITE", "Stewiacke River Park")
coastline_file <- "" # Optional local coastline .gpkg, .shp, or .rds
river_file <- ""     # Optional local Stewiacke River .gpkg, .shp, or .rds
# Your existing project folder; change this for another computer.
data_dir <- "/Users/caliyenabrown/Documents/GitHub/IBoF-Salmon-Kelts-"
output_dir <- file.path(data_dir,"migration_outputs")
data_path <- function(x) file.path(data_dir,x)
out_path <- function(x) file.path(output_dir,x)
dir.create(output_dir,recursive=TRUE,showWarnings=FALSE)
# Original cohort map extents; these expand automatically to include all locations.
map_limits <- list(
  April=list(x=c(-68.6,-63.48),y=c(44,45.69)),
  December=list(x=c(-67.15,-63.48),y=c(44.1,45.69))
)
export_csv <- function(x,name) readr::write_csv(x,out_path(name),na="NA")
parse_utc <- function(x) {
  if (inherits(x,"POSIXt")) return(lubridate::with_tz(x,"UTC"))
  if (inherits(x,"Date")) return(as.POSIXct(x,tz="UTC"))
  lubridate::parse_date_time(as.character(x),orders=c("ymd HMS","ymd HM","ymd"),
                             tz="UTC",quiet=TRUE)
}
require_cols <- function(x,cols,label) {
  absent <- setdiff(cols,names(x))
  if(length(absent)) stop(label," missing: ",paste(absent,collapse=", "))
}
```

# Import and validate data

```{r import-data}
# Check that required files exist
input_files <- c(
  "det_clean_no_release_site_det.rds",
  "meta_clean.rds",
  "predation_events_clean.rds"
)

missing_files <- input_files[!file.exists(data_path(input_files))]

if (length(missing_files) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Files missing from ", data_dir, ": ",
    paste(missing_files, collapse = ", ")
  )
}

# Import cleaned data
det <- base::readRDS(
  data_path("det_clean_no_release_site_det.rds")
)

meta_tag <- base::readRDS(
  data_path("meta_clean.rds")
)

pred <- base::readRDS(
  data_path("predation_events_clean.rds")
)

require_cols(
  det,
  c("fish", "dt", "station", "lon", "lat", "temp"),
  "Detections"
)

require_cols(
  meta_tag,
  c("fish", "release_dt"),
  "Metadata"
)

require_cols(
  pred,
  c("fish", "predation_dt"),
  "Finalized predation events"
)

# Convert tag-level metadata to one release record per fish
meta <- meta_tag %>%
  transmute(
    fish = as.character(as.integer(as.character(fish))),
    release_dt = parse_utc(release_dt)
  ) %>%
  distinct(fish, release_dt)

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(meta$fish),
  !anyNA(meta$release_dt),
  !anyDuplicated(meta$fish)
)

meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    cohort = factor(
      case_when(
        lubridate::month(release_dt) == 4 ~ "April",
        lubridate::month(release_dt) == 12 ~ "December",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      ),
      levels = cohort_levels
    )
  )

stopifnot(!anyNA(meta$cohort))

# Prepare detections from all receivers
if (!"receiver" %in% names(det)) {
  det$receiver <- NA_character_
}

det <- det %>%
  transmute(
    fish = as.character(as.integer(as.character(fish))),
    dt = parse_utc(dt),
    station = as.character(station),
    lon = as.numeric(as.character(lon)),
    lat = as.numeric(as.character(lat)),
    temp = as.numeric(as.character(temp)),
    receiver = as.character(receiver)
  )

# Record exclusions before filtering
import_audit <- tibble::tibble(
  n_input = nrow(det),
  n_missing_fish = sum(is.na(det$fish)),
  n_missing_time = sum(is.na(det$dt)),
  n_identified_outside_metadata = sum(
    !is.na(det$fish) & !det$fish %in% meta$fish
  )
)

export_csv(
  import_audit,
  "detection_import_audit.csv"
)

# Apply the same inclusion criteria as the predation analysis
det <- det %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(fish),
    !is.na(dt),
    fish %in% meta$fish
  ) %>%
  arrange(fish, dt)

detected_fish <- intersect(meta$fish, unique(det$fish))

stopifnot(length(detected_fish) > 0L)

analysis_meta <- meta %>%
  filter(fish %in% detected_fish)

export_csv(
  analysis_meta,
  "detected_fish_population.csv"
)

# Prepare finalized predation events
pred <- pred %>%
  transmute(
    fish = as.character(as.integer(as.character(fish))),
    predation_dt = parse_utc(predation_dt)
  )

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(pred),
  !anyDuplicated(pred$fish),
  all(pred$fish %in% meta$fish)
)

# Check consistency with the predation analysis:
# first temperature >20°C, excluding Fish 72
expected_pred <- det %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(temp),
    temp > 20,
    fish != "72"
  ) %>%
  group_by(fish) %>%
  summarise(
    predation_dt = min(dt),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

predation_mismatch <- full_join(
  expected_pred %>%
    rename(expected_dt = predation_dt),
  pred %>%
    rename(finalized_dt = predation_dt),
  by = "fish"
) %>%
  filter(
    is.na(expected_dt) |
      is.na(finalized_dt) |
      expected_dt != finalized_dt
  )

export_csv(
  predation_mismatch,
  "predation_event_consistency_check.csv"
)

if (nrow(predation_mismatch) > 0L) {
  stop(
    "Finalized predation events differ from the current detections. ",
    "Review predation_event_consistency_check.csv before continuing."
  )
}

# Attach release dates, cohorts, and predation times
# Retain all receiver stations, including those with missing coordinates
det <- det %>%
  left_join(meta, by = "fish") %>%
  left_join(pred, by = "fish") %>%
  arrange(fish, dt, station, receiver)

if (any(det$dt < det$release_dt)) {
  stop("Detections precede release; review timestamps.")
}

# Summarize the detected-fish population before predation truncation
population_summary <- meta %>%
  mutate(
    detected = fish %in% detected_fish
  ) %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  summarise(
    n_released = n(),
    n_detected = sum(detected),
    n_undetected = sum(!detected),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

knitr::kable(population_summary)

export_csv(
  population_summary,
  "analysis_population.csv"
)
```

# Retain pre-predation movements

The first inferred predation observation and all later records are removed.
This is stricter than retaining the event record for a temperature figure;
post-ingestion observations must not be interpreted as live kelt movements.
All non-release stations, including supplementary river and marine stations,
are retained for movement visualization.

```{r prepare-movements}
live_all <- det %>% filter(is.na(predation_dt) | dt < predation_dt)
coordinate_audit <- live_all %>% summarise(
  n_records=n(),n_missing_coordinates=sum(!is.finite(lon) | !is.finite(lat)))
knitr::kable(coordinate_audit)
export_csv(coordinate_audit,"movement_coordinate_audit.csv")
if(!nrow(live_all)) stop("No pre-predation detections available.")
movement_population_audit <- analysis_meta %>%
  left_join(live_all %>% group_by(fish) %>% summarise(
    n_pre_predation=n(),n_located_pre_predation=sum(is.finite(lon)&is.finite(lat)),
    .groups="drop"),by="fish") %>%
  mutate(n_pre_predation=replace_na(n_pre_predation,0L),
         n_located_pre_predation=replace_na(n_located_pre_predation,0L))
export_csv(movement_population_audit,"movement_population_audit.csv")
knitr::kable(movement_population_audit)

```

# Study site background layers

Local files take priority, followed by cached layers from a previous run and
then the installed source packages. All layers are transformed to WGS84 before
plotting. Missing layers produce a clear message rather than silently omitting
the study-site background. Delete the relevant cache to refresh a package layer.

```{r background-layers}
read_spatial <- function(filename) {
  if(!file.exists(filename)) stop("Spatial file not found: ",filename)
  layer <- if(tolower(tools::file_ext(filename))=="rds") {
    base::readRDS(filename)
  } else sf::st_read(filename,quiet=TRUE)
  if(!inherits(layer,c("sf","sfc"))) stop("Expected an sf spatial layer: ",filename)
  if(is.na(sf::st_crs(layer))) stop("Spatial layer has no coordinate reference system: ",filename)
  sf::st_transform(sf::st_make_valid(layer),4326)
}
land_cache <- out_path("study_site_land.rds")
river_cache <- out_path("study_site_stewiacke.rds")
if(nzchar(coastline_file)) {
  atl <- read_spatial(data_path(coastline_file))
} else if(file.exists(land_cache)) {
  atl <- read_spatial(land_cache)
} else {
  if(!requireNamespace("rnaturalearthhires",quietly=TRUE)) stop(
    "Install rnaturalearthhires before knitting, or set coastline_file to a local spatial file.")
  atl <- rnaturalearthhires::countries10
  country_column <- intersect(c("NAME_EN","ADMIN","admin","name"),names(atl))[1]
  if(is.na(country_column)) stop("Cannot find country-name column in coastline data.")
  atl <- atl %>% filter(grepl("Canada|United States",.data[[country_column]]))
  atl <- sf::st_transform(sf::st_make_valid(atl),4326)
}
if(nzchar(river_file)) {
  stewi <- read_spatial(data_path(river_file))
} else if(file.exists(river_cache)) {
  stewi <- read_spatial(river_cache)
} else {
  if(!requireNamespace("lennox",quietly=TRUE)) stop(
    "Install the lennox package before knitting, or set river_file to a local Stewiacke River spatial file.")
  stewi <- lennox::stewi
  if(is.na(sf::st_crs(stewi))) stop("Stewiacke River layer has no coordinate reference system.")
  stewi <- sf::st_transform(sf::st_make_valid(stewi),4326)
}
# Cache the layers actually used, without altering biological data.
saveRDS(atl,land_cache)
saveRDS(stewi,river_cache)
```

# Approximate movement paths

Panels show all located pre-predation observations. Colours represent elapsed
time from the actual release date for both cohorts. Grey land and the blue
Stewiacke River are repeated behind each panel. Crosses identify the final
located pre-predation observation, which need not be the fish's final observation
if later records lack coordinates. Lines connect receiver locations, not known
continuous travel routes. Simultaneous observations at distinct locations are
not connected in an arbitrary order. No receiver-grid restriction is applied.

```{r movement-paths, fig.width=14, fig.height=14}
paths <- live_all %>% filter(is.finite(lon),is.finite(lat)) %>%
  distinct(fish,dt,station,lon,lat,release_dt,cohort) %>%
  mutate(days_since_release=as.numeric(difftime(dt,release_dt,units="days"))) %>%
  group_by(fish,dt) %>% mutate(n_locations_at_time=n_distinct(paste(lon,lat))) %>% ungroup() %>%
  arrange(fish,dt,station)
paths <- paths %>% group_by(fish) %>% mutate(
  segment=cumsum(n_locations_at_time>1 | lag(n_locations_at_time>1,default=FALSE))) %>% ungroup()
export_csv(paths,"pre_predation_movement_locations.csv")
map_extent_audit <- list()
for(cc in cohort_levels) {
  x <- paths %>% filter(cohort==cc)
  if(!nrow(x)) next
  # Numeric facet ordering: Fish 1, 2, 3, ... rather than 1, 10, 11, ...
  fish_levels <- as.character(sort(unique(as.integer(x$fish))))
  x <- x %>% mutate(fish=factor(fish,levels=fish_levels))
  last_points <- x %>% group_by(fish) %>% filter(dt==max(dt)) %>% ungroup()
  xlim <- range(c(map_limits[[cc]]$x,x$lon-0.03,x$lon+0.03))
  ylim <- range(c(map_limits[[cc]]$y,x$lat-0.03,x$lat+0.03))
  map_extent_audit[[cc]] <- tibble::tibble(cohort=cc,xmin=xlim[1],xmax=xlim[2],
                                          ymin=ylim[1],ymax=ylim[2])
  bbox <- sf::st_bbox(c(xmin=xlim[1],xmax=xlim[2],ymin=ylim[1],ymax=ylim[2]),
                       crs=sf::st_crs(4326))
  land_plot <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_crop(atl,bbox))
  river_plot <- suppressWarnings(sf::st_crop(stewi,bbox))
  # Background layers come first so land never hides movement observations.
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_sf(data=land_plot,fill="lightgray",colour="darkgray",linewidth=0.2) +
    geom_sf(data=river_plot,colour="dodgerblue3",linewidth=0.45) +
    geom_path(data=x %>% filter(n_locations_at_time==1),
      aes(lon,lat,group=interaction(fish,segment),colour=days_since_release),
      linewidth=0.5,alpha=0.8) +
    geom_point(data=x,aes(lon,lat,colour=days_since_release),size=0.7,alpha=0.6) +
    geom_point(data=last_points,aes(lon,lat),shape=4,size=2.5,stroke=1,
               colour="darkblue") +
    facet_wrap(~fish,ncol=4) +
    coord_sf(crs=sf::st_crs(4326),default_crs=sf::st_crs(4326),
             xlim=xlim,ylim=ylim,datum=NA,expand=FALSE) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option="rocket",name="Days since release") +
    labs(title=paste(cc,"release"),x=NULL,y=NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size=12) +
    theme(panel.grid=element_blank(),axis.text=element_blank(),axis.ticks=element_blank(),
      legend.position="bottom",legend.key.width=grid::unit(3,"cm"),
      strip.text=element_text(face="bold",size=12),
      plot.title=element_text(face="bold",hjust=0.5),
      plot.background=element_rect(fill="white",colour=NA))
  print(p)
  if(cc=="April") april_map <- p else december_map <- p
  map_height <- max(5,ceiling(n_distinct(x$fish)/4)*2.5)
  ggsave(out_path(paste0(tolower(cc),"_movement_paths.png")),p,
         width=14,height=map_height,dpi=300,limitsize=FALSE,bg="white")
  ggsave(out_path(paste0(tolower(cc),"_movement_paths.pdf")),p,
         width=14,height=map_height,limitsize=FALSE,bg="white")
}
export_csv(dplyr::bind_rows(map_extent_audit),"movement_map_extents.csv")
```

# Detection durations and reproducibility

Durations below describe observation windows, not confirmed continuous
residence or survival. All detected fish are listed in the population table. A fish without a located
pre-predation detection has no drawable movement path and is listed in the audit.

```{r summaries}
movement_summary <- live_all %>% group_by(fish,cohort,release_dt) %>% summarise(
  first_detection=min(dt),last_detection=max(dt),n_records=n(),
  n_stations=n_distinct(station),n_days_detected=n_distinct(as.Date(dt)),
  days_release_to_last=as.numeric(difftime(max(dt),first(release_dt),units="days")),
  .groups="drop")
knitr::kable(movement_summary,digits=2)
export_csv(movement_summary,"individual_detection_durations.csv")
inputs <- c("det_clean_no_release_site_det.rds","predation_events_clean.rds","meta_clean.rds")
if(nzchar(coastline_file)) inputs <- c(inputs,coastline_file)
if(nzchar(river_file)) inputs <- c(inputs,river_file)
export_csv(tibble(file=inputs,md5=unname(tools::md5sum(data_path(inputs)))),"input_checksums.csv")
capture.output(sessionInfo(),file=out_path("migration_session_info.txt"))
```
